Welcome to the Arcanum Seekers, Field Researcher. I'm High Seeker Elara Voss. The Concordium calls us reckless and the Iron Hegemony calls us dangerous — we call ourselves the only people on Xylos who are asking the right questions instead of just fortifying the answers they already have. Your first field assignment is on the Crystal Slope. The Wild Mushrooms there absorb raw aethel directly from a Shard fragment impact site. Their tissue contains energy signatures that predate the Great Severance. We need those signatures.

options.text: I need to think about it.

nodes.text: The Aethelgardians who built the Aethel Siphon understood aethel energy at a fundamental level that we have been reconstructing from ruins for two centuries. The Crystal Slope sits on a direct Shard fragment impact point — one of the scatter sites where the original Shard dispersed when it shattered in the Great Severance. The Wild Mushrooms that have grown over this site are not random organisms, Subject. They are biological data storage: living tissue that has absorbed and encoded pre-Severance aethel signatures over three hundred years of contact. Those signatures are our most direct access to what the Aethelgardians knew before the Siphon overloaded and destroyed everything. The fact that obtaining them requires combat is a methodology compromise, not a philosophical one.
Field Specimens: First Watch 01. In Crystal Slope: Defeat 3 SHARDLING. Record what you observe after the encounter. A result without context is only another rumor.

The Crystal Sproutlings on this slope are not simply obstacles, Field Researcher. I believe they are conscious. Primitively, at the level of a single persistent idea perhaps, but the energy signature data from our previous collection suggests a form of biological coherence that standard Xylos fauna don't exhibit. The Concordium classified this research as 'ethically complex' and buried it in their restricted archive. The Arcanum opened it anyway.

options.text: I need to think about it.

nodes.text: Crystal Sproutlings grow from Shard fragment deposits — they are, technically, living extensions of the same material that shattered in the Great Severance. The Concordium wants them cleared as threats. The Children of the Shard would want them protected as sacred relics. We want their consciousness-signature data, because if these organisms carry biological memory encoded by the Shard's fracture pattern, that memory could tell us things about the Aethelgardians' original intent for the Siphon that no written archive has preserved. The Concordium's ethical classification is not a philosophical objection — it's administrative anxiety. There is a difference.
Field Specimens: Broken Signal 01. In Crystal Slope: Defeat 3 SHARDLING. Record what you observe after the encounter. A result without context is only another rumor.

I'm Archivist Sylas. I maintain what the Arcanum calls the living archive — our collection of specimens, artifacts, and data constituting institutional knowledge no single researcher can hold alone. High Seeker Voss has sent you to me because I have a hypothesis that requires specimens I cannot collect myself. The Shardlings on this slope are not random creatures. I believe each one contains a fractional encoded memory of the original Aethel Shard — a fractal pattern of the whole, distributed across biological hosts.

options.text: I need to think about it.

nodes.text: The fractal hypothesis began with the Sproutling consciousness data. If Sproutlings carry primitive coherent awareness derived from Shard contact, and Shardlings are organisms that developed from direct fragment integration, then the Shardling population may collectively encode the Shard's pre-fracture information state. The fracture pattern itself — the way the Shard shattered, where each fragment landed — may not have been random. The Aethelgardians may have engineered the Shard to fracture in a recoverable pattern, a fail-safe in the event the Siphon failed. If I am right, we could theoretically reconstruct the Shard's original data state from biological specimens. The Concordium has never considered this possibility because they stopped asking questions the moment the Cradle started working again.
Field Specimens: Ashes on the Route 01. In Crystal Slope: Defeat 3 SHARDLING. Record what you observe after the encounter. A result without context is only another rumor.

An Aethelgardian text recovered from the Resonance Caverns — one of the Arcanum's most prized possessions, classified by the Concordium and recovered during the chaos of the Schism — describes Crystal Wisps as 'light-formed messengers, carrying the speech of those who built the Siphon.' The Concordium wants them dead. The Arcanum wants their energy signatures mapped. These are different objectives, Field Researcher, and the difference matters enormously.

options.text: I need to think about it.

nodes.text: The Aethelgardian text provides a partial translation framework for Wisp energy patterns: they are not random light emissions but structured data bursts — the same communication protocol the Aethelgardians used to transmit technical information across the Siphon's operational network. Every Wisp that flickers out is a word from before the Severance, lost forever. Our capture equipment can preserve the energy signature at the moment of dispersal — essentially recording the Wisp's final transmission. We have been building a corpus of these recordings for six years. When we have enough, we may be able to reconstruct complete Aethelgardian technical instructions from the accumulated data. The Concordium has never attempted this because they are not interested in what the Aethelgardians were saying. Only in what they built.
Field Specimens: Quiet Perimeter 01. In Crystal Slope: Defeat 3 CRYSTAL_WISP. Record what you observe after the encounter. A result without context is only another rumor.

I am Archsage Myr. The Observatory Spire was built by the Arcanum to watch the stars and read the aethel currents that flow between them — and because the person who designed it believed that the Aethelgardians were communicating something in the pattern of the Shard fragment scatter, and that pattern would only be visible from sufficient altitude. I have reviewed your field reports. High Seeker Voss and Archivist Sylas both recommend you. In the Arcanum, knowledge specialization is not a promotion. It is a philosophical declaration.

options.text: I need to think about it.

nodes.text: The Arcanum recognizes three lines of inquiry — not classes, not tactical roles, but commitments about what questions you will spend your life pursuing. The Resonance Seeker listens: studying frequencies, emissions, and the hidden communications embedded in aethel phenomena, following the Wisp translation project's methodology. The Void Architect constructs: building frameworks for understanding void energy and its relationship to the Shard, working toward practical applications the Concordium hasn't imagined. The Crystal Sage synthesizes: combining biological specimen data with Aethelgardian technical records to reconstruct lost knowledge from fragments. The wrong answer will not be punished — the Arcanum does not punish intellectual honesty. But it will shape everything you investigate from this day forward.
Field Specimens: A Debt Repaid 01. In Crystal Slope: Defeat 3 GLASS_CRAWLER. Record what you observe after the encounter. A result without context is only another rumor.

The Fractured Glass Valley was a functioning Aethelgardian research station before the Severance shattered it — and the terrain along with it. The valley's glass formations are the remnants of research structures that were conducting experiments the Concordium still cannot categorize from the fragments we've recovered. I've been trying to get a team into this valley for years. The Concordium kept classifying it restricted. Post-Schism, in the fracture of competing jurisdictions, the Arcanum moves where others hesitate. Get in before anyone else does.

options.text: I need to think about it.

nodes.text: The restriction was bureaucratic cowardice. The Concordium's position was that the valley's 'unstable terrain' made access 'inadvisable.' The actual reason, which their internal correspondence reveals to anyone willing to access the Arcanum's recovered archive fragments, is that the pre-Severance research conducted here involved aethel applications that the Concordium's post-Schism engineering division cannot replicate and doesn't want the general population to know about. Data slates buried in the crystalline formations contain material science experiment records that our current understanding cannot fully categorize. That is precisely why we are here. The Concordium restricts what it cannot understand. The Arcanum investigates it.
Field Specimens: The Missing Patrol 01. In Crystal Slope: Defeat 3 GLASS_CRAWLER. Record what you observe after the encounter. A result without context is only another rumor.

I'm Archivist Sylas. I have been studying the Glass Crawlers' locomotion pattern in this valley for three months and I believe I have found something extraordinary. Their movement technique — the way they distribute weight across the razor-glass substrate without cutting themselves — follows a stress-distribution algorithm that precisely matches a partial specification recovered from the research station's structural engineering archives. They didn't evolve this solution. They inherited it.

options.text: I need to think about it.

nodes.text: The implication is significant. The Aethelgardian research station was conducting biological integration experiments — attempting to encode engineering solutions into living organisms' behavioral genetics. If the Glass Crawlers' locomotion is a survival of that research, it means the station's biological experiments were successful enough that the encoded behaviors persisted through three hundred years of independent evolution. The Crawlers are, in a meaningful sense, living Aethelgardian documentation — organisms that remember engineering solutions their creators recorded in their genetics. That movement data could reshape Arcanum field equipment design and tell us what else the Aethelgardians may have successfully encoded in Xylos's native fauna.
Field Specimens: Measure of Resolve 01. In Crystal Slope: Defeat 3 ARCANE_SHARDLING. Record what you observe after the encounter. A result without context is only another rumor.

A Giant Alpha Rat has claimed the valley's sealed archive chamber as its nest. This is the chamber our scouts confirmed still contains pre-Severance data cylinders intact after three hundred years. The chamber's aethel-key sealing mechanism kept the biological contamination of the Severance out. It did not keep out a rat that found the ventilation shaft. The Concordium had this chamber on their survey maps for decades and left it sealed. The Arcanum broke through last season. A rat will not reclaim what human curiosity has finally unlocked.

options.text: I need to think about it.

nodes.text: The data cylinders in that chamber were sealed by Aethelgardian archivists who understood the Siphon was failing. They preserved what they could before the Great Severance destroyed everything else. Three hundred years of perfect environmental sealing — the aethel-key technology creates an atmosphere-isolated container that resists biological and energetic contamination simultaneously. The Alpha Rat's colony is using the document storage containers as nesting material. Every week the Alpha remains in that chamber, more cylinders are compromised. The Concordium's decades of neglect made this possible. The Arcanum cannot afford the same mistake.
Field Specimens: A Narrow Passage 01. In Crystal Slope: Defeat 3 ARCANE_SHARDLING. Record what you observe after the encounter. A result without context is only another rumor.

I'm Researcher Vin. My field specialization is energy signature analysis — I measure what things emit and attempt to understand what those emissions mean about the emitter's underlying nature. The Glass Wisps in this valley have presented me with what I can only describe as a professional emergency: their energy signatures are so complex that my standard field equipment cannot parse them. High Seeker Voss finds this exciting. I find it a calibration problem I need to solve.

options.text: I need to think about it.

nodes.text: The standard Crystal Wisp emits energy in patterns consistent with simple harmonic resonance — first-order transmissions, in the Aethelgardian terminology, basically a single sustained note. The Glass Wisps are emitting recursive harmonic structures: patterns that reference themselves, that contain within them scaled-down versions of the whole emission signature. This is what the Arcanum's theoretical models predict for aethel entities that have spent generations in high-compression radiation environments — the Fractured Glass Valley's crystalline substrate concentrates ambient aethel to levels three to four times higher than the Crystal Slope. These Wisps are not just older Crystal Wisps. They are something qualitatively different, and my equipment was designed for the simpler version.
Field Specimens: Unclaimed Ground 01. In Crystal Slope: Defeat 3 CRYSTAL_SKITTER. Record what you observe after the encounter. A result without context is only another rumor.

The Crystal Rams in the valley's deepest ravine have horns I have been studying for fourteen months. Not the keratin structure itself — the electromagnetic pattern they emit. The Rams' horns grow by absorbing the deep aethel currents flowing through the valley's crystalline substrate, the same currents that once powered Aethelgardian technology. The resulting biological structure is, functionally, an aethel conduit grown over decades into a shape that mirrors the Siphon's internal routing architecture. They solved in biology what the Aethelgardians solved in engineering.

options.text: I need to think about it.

nodes.text: I have a reconstruction project I have not shared with the Concordium and will not share with the Concordium. The project involves building a functional small-scale replica of the Siphon's internal aethel routing system using biological components — specifically, the electromagnetic pattern of the Crystal Ram horn as a template for the routing geometry. If the Aethelgardians were encoding engineering solutions in Xylos's native fauna, the Crystal Rams may be the most sophisticated example we've found. The horn's pattern is not just similar to the Siphon's routing architecture. It is structurally identical to specifications from pre-Severance construction documents that the Concordium classified before the Schism and that I recovered from their restricted archive through means I prefer not to detail.

payload.name: Full Recovery Pack

payload.name: Sterile Water
payload.description: Purified field water used to assemble medical cells and nutrient supplies.

payload.name: Carbon Census Slip
payload.description: Recovered at The Unlisted Ward. Two chairs face an empty doorway. Only the smaller chair has fresh repairs. Household numbers continue across a wall that modern surveys label vacant. A field record, not an established answer to Xylos's ancient mysteries.

payload.name: Folded Relocation Notice
payload.description: Recovered at The Unlisted Ward. Two chairs face an empty doorway. Only the smaller chair has fresh repairs. Household numbers continue across a wall that modern surveys label vacant. A field record, not an established answer to Xylos's ancient mysteries.

payload.name: Mended Doorplate
payload.description: A repaired doorplate, returned with permission. An empty address is not an empty life.

payload.name: Double-Stamped Census Seal
payload.description: Two legitimate marks preserved on one seal. Agreement is not the same as accuracy.

payload.name: Retired Authorization Key
payload.description: A retired municipal key, preserved as evidence of a failed register rather than a trophy taken from a resident.

payload.name: Foldkeeper's Ribbon
payload.description: A ribbon used to refold a notice. Information can remain useful without becoming public.

payload.name: Ring of the Unlisted Ward
payload.description: A ring engraved with a doorway and no name. Recognition without possession.

payload.name: Scorched Bell Tally
payload.description: Recovered at Hollow Muster Yard. A muster bell hangs over boots facing away from the parade line. A second rope leads into a workshop, not a command tower. A field record, not an established answer to Xylos's ancient mysteries.

payload.name: Workshop Evacuation Roll
payload.description: Recovered at Hollow Muster Yard. A muster bell hangs over boots facing away from the parade line. A second rope leads into a workshop, not a command tower. A field record, not an established answer to Xylos's ancient mysteries.

payload.name: Fourth-Beat Clapper
payload.description: A discarded bell clapper. Its worth lies in the warning people finally heard.

payload.name: Outward Step Tag
payload.description: A civilian tool tag whose owner left through the proper safety exit.

payload.name: Salvage-Locked Ferrule
payload.description: A sheared cable ferrule kept to teach future repair crews what the failure looked like.

payload.name: Two-Stamp Work Token
payload.description: A work token stamped by two suppliers. Cooperation on one shift does not erase their disagreement.

payload.name: Bellwright's Wrist Loop
payload.description: A loop braided from retired bell rope. It honors maintenance, not a borrowed military oath.

payload.name: Blank-Cargo Manifest
payload.description: Recovered at Zero Berth Customs Annex. A berth marked zero contains a crate with an inward-facing shipping stencil. A polished scale shows the same value even with no cargo. A field record, not an established answer to Xylos's ancient mysteries.

payload.name: Nested Storage Invoice
payload.description: Recovered at Zero Berth Customs Annex. A berth marked zero contains a crate with an inward-facing shipping stencil. A polished scale shows the same value even with no cargo. A field record, not an established answer to Xylos's ancient mysteries.

payload.name: Zero Berth Brass Weight
payload.description: A tare weight marked zero cargo. It distinguishes a valid storage fee from an invented shipment.

payload.name: Inward-Facing Shipping Seal
payload.description: A shipping seal from a returned container; its orientation explains its record.

payload.name: Broken Fee Counterseal
payload.description: A fee seal invalidated for unauthorized use. A collector's misconduct is not a judgment on an entire port.

payload.name: Nested Invoice Divider
payload.description: A ledger divider used to separate one service from two charges.

payload.name: Zero Berth Signet
payload.description: A signet bearing an empty crate. Earned by correcting a claim without condemning everyone who trades.

payload.name: Cloth-Bound Resonance Trace
payload.description: Recovered at Quiet Resonator Gallery. Three resonant ribs surround a fourth rib wrapped in old cloth. A listening bench faces away from the visible crystals toward a drainage channel. A field record, not an established answer to Xylos's ancient mysteries.

payload.name: Drainage Interval Record
payload.description: Recovered at Quiet Resonator Gallery. Three resonant ribs surround a fourth rib wrapped in old cloth. A listening bench faces away from the visible crystals toward a drainage channel. A field record, not an established answer to Xylos's ancient mysteries.

payload.name: Quiet-Rib Tuning Fork
payload.description: A fork tuned to a damped rib. Its tone is an observation, not a divine translation.

payload.name: Backward Listener's Token
payload.description: A token showing a bench turned away from spectacle and toward the sound's actual path.

payload.name: Gallery Boundary Knot
payload.description: A boundary cord from a limited field test. A useful result need not justify unlimited intrusion.

payload.name: Twin-Interval Crystal
payload.description: A crystal carrying two measured intervals. Similarity is evidence; intention is not established.

payload.name: Quiet Gallery Pendant
payload.description: A pendant engraved with a measured pause. It honors the limits of a finding, not mastery of the Shard.

payload.name: Scorched Relief Ledger Leaf
payload.description: Recovered at Sealed Armistice Vault. New lock bolts hold an old stone cabinet shut. A scorched relief ledger sits beside an undamaged metal duplicate, both bearing the same modern custody mark. A field record, not an established answer to Xylos's ancient mysteries.

payload.name: Modern Custody Duplicate
payload.description: Recovered at Sealed Armistice Vault. New lock bolts hold an old stone cabinet shut. A scorched relief ledger sits beside an undamaged metal duplicate, both bearing the same modern custody mark. A field record, not an established answer to Xylos's ancient mysteries.

payload.name: Modern-on-Ancient Custody Seal
payload.description: A modern seal from an old chamber. Its custody date is not the chamber's age.

payload.name: Heat-Line Witness Plate
payload.description: A plate tracing the limit of heat damage. It records a pattern, not an accusation.

payload.name: Paired Copyist's Clip
payload.description: A clip used to keep two independently witnessed archive copies together.

payload.name: Unsettled Reserve Countertoken
payload.description: An audit countertoken identifying a reserve without pretending the people waiting for it suffered no cost.

payload.name: Signet of the Unwritten Witness
payload.description: Five grooves surround an unfinished witness line. The final groove remains open for a correction not yet heard.

payload.name: Civic Oath Seal
payload.description: The ration crews are moving again. You held the line without forgetting who stood behind it. Issued by Instructor Kael as proof of the Base trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Routekeeper Warrant
payload.description: The route is open. I can assign crews to it, rather than merely drawing it on a map. Issued by Field Captain Ilyra as proof of the Advance trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Cradle Stabilization Charter
payload.description: Your report is sound. The protocol can now be rewritten around what actually happened. Issued by Inspector Soren as proof of the Expert trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Concordium Steward Sigil
payload.description: Every name on my list has a route out. This sigil carries their trust, not just my signature. Issued by Marshal Elian as proof of the Master trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Resonance Thesis Prism
payload.description: An honest record, including uncertainty. That is a better beginning than a spectacular claim. Issued by Archsage Myr as proof of the Base trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Echo Calibration Lens
payload.description: The baseline holds. We can enter those caverns with a reasoned plan rather than a wish. Issued by Resonant Scholar Eira as proof of the Advance trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Peer Witness Crystal
payload.description: Your evidence survives scrutiny. The witness crystal certifies the work, not infallibility. Issued by Examiner Thalen as proof of the Expert trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Arcanum Living Codex
payload.description: The expedition has returned. This codex remains open: your mastery includes admitting what we still do not know. Issued by First Archivist Neris as proof of the Master trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Tempered Service Rivet
payload.description: The recovery lanes are usable. Good. That rivet was tempered in work, not ceremony. Issued by War Marshal Drax as proof of the Base trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Supplyline Iron Writ
payload.description: Supplies are moving. The crews will notice your result before they ever learn your rank. Issued by Quartermaster Rusk as proof of the Advance trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Forge Control Crest
payload.description: The shutdown held. You chose the crews over a pleasing output figure. Issued by Forge Inspector Maela as proof of the Expert trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Bastion Command Plate
payload.description: The lattice is under our control. Take the plate, and remember exactly what command costs. Issued by General Torren as proof of the Master trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Vex's Signed Passage
payload.description: The ferry crew is safe. A useful favor, and a signature I will remember. Issued by Captain Vex as proof of the Base trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Unlisted Route Cipher
payload.description: The carriers are moving. Your cipher is earned; the network will answer your call. Issued by Route Broker Lysa as proof of the Advance trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Deepwater Guarantee Seal
payload.description: The divers came back breathing. That is a guarantee I am willing to sign. Issued by Diver Marshal Corin as proof of the Expert trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Meridian Covenant Coin
payload.description: No one was left below. Keep the coin. It is a promise with witnesses, not loose currency. Issued by Keeper of Debts Sable as proof of the Master trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Astra's Competency Wafer
payload.description: Result verified. The wafer is signed. Your next discipline will be judged by what you do with it. Issued by Director Astra Vey as proof of the Base trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Delta Recovery License
payload.description: The crew has safe access. That is the recovery figure I am filing. Issued by Operations Lead Tessa Lin as proof of the Advance trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Reactor Override Key
payload.description: Access is restored and the audit trail is intact. Your override key is approved. Issued by Chief Auditor Ren as proof of the Expert trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: OmniCorp Executive Mandate
payload.description: The failure was contained here. Your mandate records a decision we are prepared to stand behind. Issued by Executive Director Iona Hale as proof of the Master trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Listening Shard
payload.description: The seed keepers can pass. Hold the shard gently; learning to listen has only begun. Issued by Oracle Seraphel as proof of the Base trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Rootmemory Votive
payload.description: The root paths are open. Your votive remembers the people who can use them again. Issued by Root Listener Amara as proof of the Advance trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Heartwood Witness Stone
payload.description: You named the wound and made room to mend it. The witness stone carries that truth. Issued by Woundkeeper Oriel as proof of the Expert trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Sanctum Keeper Reliquary
payload.description: Those who follow us will have a safe approach. The reliquary holds your vow to keep listening. Issued by Elder Naeva as proof of the Master trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Valka's Formation Knot
payload.description: The water runners are back. Tie the knot yourself. You have a place beside us. Issued by Centurion Valka as proof of the Base trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Marchwarden Standard Tab
payload.description: The march can continue. This tab belongs on a standard carried with others. Issued by Marchwarden Sera as proof of the Advance trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Rollkeeper Steel Token
payload.description: The work crews have returned to the rolls. Keep this token where you can feel its weight. Issued by Rollkeeper Bren as proof of the Expert trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.name: Starforged Hearth Standard
payload.description: The approach is ours again. Raise the hearth standard for a home people can live in. Issued by Legate Ashra as proof of the Master trial. Consumed once when choosing a class.

payload.skill_description: A tight blast that knocks back.

payload.name: Shape the Room
payload.effect: A cone blast that opens a path.
payload.skill_description: A cone blast that opens a path.

payload.name: Perfect Blast
payload.effect: A sculpted explosion. Center is stunned, edge is only knocked back.
payload.skill_description: A sculpted explosion. Center is stunned, edge is only knocked back.

payload.name: False Trace
payload.effect: After a hack, you gain stealth and the target's allies see a false position.
payload.skill_description: After a hack, you gain stealth and the target's allies see a false position.

payload.name: Ghost Spike
payload.effect: Hack and blink away.
payload.skill_description: Hack and blink away.

payload.name: Spoof
payload.effect: Leave a false trace that taunts devices.
payload.skill_description: Leave a false trace that taunts devices.

payload.name: Protocol Zero
payload.effect: Silence an area and drop off the map for a turn.
payload.skill_description: Silence an area and drop off the map for a turn.

payload.name: Resident Daemon
payload.effect: One daemon persists between casts and ticks damage.
payload.skill_description: One daemon persists between casts and ticks damage.

payload.name: Install
payload.effect: Install a daemon that deals damage over time.
payload.skill_description: Install a daemon that deals damage over time.

payload.name: Steal Cycle
payload.effect: Increase the target's cooldowns and reduce yours.
payload.skill_description: Increase the target's cooldowns and reduce yours.

payload.name: Coronation
payload.effect: Upgrade every daemon. They silence and burst.
payload.skill_description: Upgrade every daemon. They silence and burst.

payload.name: Live Edit
payload.effect: Heals you cast can also cleanse. Mutations you apply last longer.
payload.skill_description: Heals you cast can also cleanse. Mutations you apply last longer.

payload.name: Close the Wound
payload.effect: Strong heal and a short regen.
payload.skill_description: Strong heal and a short regen.

payload.name: Forced Mutation
payload.effect: Damage and reduce defense.
payload.skill_description: Damage and reduce defense.

payload.name: Rewrite
payload.effect: Swap a debuff on an ally into a buff, and a buff on an enemy into a debuff.
payload.skill_description: Swap a debuff on an ally into a buff, and a buff on an enemy into a debuff.

payload.name: Living Plate
payload.effect: You and nearby allies grow a small regenerating shield.
payload.skill_description: You and nearby allies grow a small regenerating shield.

payload.name: Grow Armor
payload.effect: Grant an ally defense and regen.
payload.skill_description: Grant an ally defense and regen.

payload.name: Bone Spike
payload.effect: A grown spike that roots.
payload.skill_description: A grown spike that roots.

payload.name: Organism
payload.effect: Link the squad. Healing is shared and everyone gains HP.
payload.skill_description: Link the squad. Healing is shared and everyone gains HP.

payload.name: Jump Strain
payload.effect: Blight jumps twice and lasts longer.
payload.skill_description: Blight jumps twice and lasts longer.

payload.name: Patient Zero
payload.effect: Apply a blight that is eager to spread.
payload.skill_description: Apply a blight that is eager to spread.

payload.name: Cough Cloud
payload.effect: Leave a cloud of poison.
payload.skill_description: Leave a cloud of poison.

payload.name: Pandemic
payload.effect: Every blighted enemy bursts and infects neighbors.
payload.skill_description: Every blighted enemy bursts and infects neighbors.

payload.name: Drink the Work
payload.effect: You heal for a portion of blight and poison damage.
payload.skill_description: You heal for a portion of blight and poison damage.

payload.name: Lord's Touch
payload.effect: Melee blight that heals you.
payload.skill_description: Melee blight that heals you.

payload.name: Siphon Cloud
payload.effect: Pull blight damage into a self heal.
payload.skill_description: Pull blight damage into a self heal.

payload.name: Throne of Rot
payload.effect: A personal aura of blight. You regenerate while it ticks.
payload.skill_description: A personal aura of blight. You regenerate while it ticks.

payload.name: Enforcer
payload.description: Front-line fighter trained to hold ground. Trades mobility for raw staying power and straightforward strikes.

payload.name: Vanguard
payload.description: Shield-first advance of the Enforcer. Specializes in absorbing pressure so the line behind them never breaks.

payload.name: Dreadnought
payload.description: Living siege engine. Enormous health and armor let a Dreadnought walk through volleys that would drop a squad.

payload.name: Sentinel
payload.description: Immovable guardian. Almost nothing gets past a Sentinel's guard, at the cost of limited offense.

payload.name: Berserker
payload.description: Enforcer who abandons defense for fury. Hits harder the longer a fight lasts, and bleeds for it.

payload.name: Warlord
payload.description: Battlefield tyrant. Turns personal rage into commanding presence and crushing weapon swings.

payload.name: Ravager
payload.description: Bleeding-edge berserker. Chains wounds and keeps moving so the target never gets a clean recovery.

payload.name: Dragoon
payload.description: Polearm specialist who mixes Enforcer weight with sudden bursts of speed.

payload.name: Skyreaver
payload.description: Aerial lancer. Closes distance in a leap and leaves the target exposed before they can reset.

payload.name: Void Lancer
payload.description: Perception-tuned lancer who aims at weak points and pierces through cover.

payload.name: Strider
payload.description: Light fighter built on footwork and awareness. Survives by not being where the blow lands.

payload.name: Assassin
payload.description: Close-range killer. Opens from a blind angle and finishes before the target turns.

payload.name: Shadowblade
payload.description: Darkness duelist. Stacks critical windows and vanishes between exchanges.

payload.name: Phantom
payload.description: Misdirection specialist. Reads intent, then punishes the swing that was never going to land.

payload.name: Ranger
payload.description: Tracker and marksman. Reads terrain, wind, and prey before the first shot.

payload.name: BeastExpert
payload.description: Ranger who fights with a bonded beast. Shares senses and splits the enemy's attention.

payload.name: Sniper Elite
payload.description: Extreme-range shooter. One clean shot is worth more than a magazine of panic fire.

payload.name: Gunslinger
payload.description: Hip-fire specialist. Perception and agility keep the cylinder turning and the feet moving.

payload.name: Desperado
payload.description: Duelist of the open street. Wins by drawing first and refusing to stand still.

payload.name: Tech-Drifter
payload.description: Gunhand wired into scavenged tech. Mixes ballistics with gadgets and short-range hacks.

payload.name: Channeler
payload.description: Conduit for ambient power. Perception opens the channel; mana keeps it stable.

payload.name: Mystic
payload.description: Pure channeler. Deepens perception until spells land with very little waste.

payload.name: Archon
payload.description: High conduit. Enormous mana and perception make an Archon the center of any ritual fight.

payload.name: Chronomancer
payload.description: Time-bent mystic. Steals beats from the turn order and spends them as extra actions.

payload.name: Warpriest
payload.description: Channeler who takes the oath onto the front line. Faith, steel, and a smaller mana pool.

payload.name: Templar
payload.description: Armored warpriest. Holds consecrated ground and keeps allies standing inside it.

payload.name: Arbiter
payload.description: Judgment caster. Weighs a target and spends mana to enforce the verdict.

payload.name: Summoner
payload.description: Channeler who spends mana to call something else into the fight.

payload.name: Void Caller
payload.description: Summoner of rifts. Pulls hostile entities from elsewhere and points them at a target.

payload.name: Golemancer
payload.description: Summoner of constructs. Builds a body that soaks damage the caster cannot.

payload.name: Machinist
payload.description: Hands-on tinkerer. Perception finds the fault; a tool or a shot exploits it.

payload.name: Artificer
payload.description: Device specialist. Turns scavenged parts into repeatable combat tools.

payload.name: Mecha Pilot
payload.description: Artificer in a frame. The suit carries the hp and the pilot carries the targeting.

payload.name: Cyber-Architect
payload.description: Systems builder. Raises temporary structures and defensive grids mid-fight.

payload.name: Saboteur
payload.description: Machinist who breaks things on purpose. Fast hands, planted charges, cut lines.

payload.name: Demolitionist
payload.description: Charge specialist. Shapes blasts so the kill zone is intentional, not accidental.

payload.name: Netrunner
payload.description: Intrusion specialist. Burns mana-like focus to hijack devices and living systems alike.

payload.name: Alchemist
payload.description: Compound specialist. Mixes reagents into effects the body cannot ignore.

payload.name: Bio-Engineer
payload.description: Alchemist of living tissue. Rewrites a wound into a recovery, or a recovery into a weapon.

payload.name: Plague Spreader
payload.description: Weaponized chemist. Seeds a status and lets the fight do the rest of the work.

payload.name: Iron Colossus
payload.description: Dreadnought who stopped being a soldier and became a wall. Absorbs siege fire and answers with a step that shakes the line.

payload.name: Siegebreaker
payload.description: Dreadnought turned into a ram. Still absurdly hard to drop, but built to open gates, shields, and formations.

payload.name: Aegis Ward
payload.description: Sentinel whose guard extends past their own body. Plants a ward and makes the space behind it expensive to enter.

payload.name: Bulwark
payload.description: Personal fortress. Gives up reach for a guard stance that barely moves, even under ultimates.

payload.name: Conqueror
payload.description: Warlord who fights as a banner. Personal damage is high, and nearby allies hit harder while the Conqueror is standing.

payload.name: Blood Tyrant
payload.description: Warlord who spends their own blood as fuel. Peak single-target brutality with almost no safety margin.

payload.name: Gorefiend
payload.description: Ravager obsessed with open wounds. Every hit extends a bleed and punishes anyone already leaking.

payload.name: Rampager
payload.description: Ravager who never resets. Chains dashes through a pack and leaves a trail of half-finished kills.

payload.name: Stormlancer
payload.description: Skyreaver who rides the fall. Leap, impact, and a shock that staggers everyone near the landing.

payload.name: Skydancer
payload.description: Skyreaver who treats the air as cover. Evades more than they tank, and punishes the whiff.

payload.name: Riftpiercer
payload.description: Void Lancer who opens a short rift on the thrust. The hit ignores a slice of defense and arrives early.

payload.name: Eclipse Lancer
payload.description: Void Lancer who blacks out a target's read. Marks a weak point, then blinds the window they needed to dodge.

payload.name: Night Reaper
payload.description: Shadowblade who only commits when the target is isolated. Execute windows are short and absolute.

payload.name: Umbral Duelist
payload.description: Shadowblade who duels in the dark. Counters the next swing and answers from the off-hand.

payload.name: Wraith
payload.description: Phantom who slips out of the hitbox. A missed attack against a Wraith is often the last clean action the attacker gets.

payload.name: Mirage
payload.description: Phantom who fights with copies. The real body is rarely the one the enemy committed to.

payload.name: Pack Alpha
payload.description: Beastmaster who leads more than one bond. The pack splits focus and the Alpha finishes whatever is marked.

payload.name: Wildbound
payload.description: Beastmaster who shares a body-sense with the beast. Moves as one unit and covers the angles the other cannot.

payload.name: Deadeye
payload.description: Sniper Elite at the edge of the map. Holds a shot until the weak point is certain, then ends the exchange.

payload.name: Ghost Marksman
payload.description: Sniper Elite who relocates after every shot. The second round never comes from the same nest.

payload.name: Outlaw King
payload.description: Desperado who owns the street. Fan-fire and a presence that makes allies braver and targets sloppier.

payload.name: Quickdraw Saint
payload.description: Desperado whose draw is a ritual. Wins the first frame of a duel and rarely needs a third shot.

payload.name: Chrome Gunner
payload.description: Tech-Drifter bolted into a heavier rig. Smart rounds, heat sinks, and a gun that does not jam when the fight gets ugly.

payload.name: Circuit Cowboy
payload.description: Tech-Drifter who hacks between shots. A tagged enemy fights with one system already lying to them.

payload.name: Ascendant
payload.description: Archon who stopped channeling and started overflowing. Spells are larger, longer, and much more expensive.

payload.name: Oracle Prime
payload.description: Archon who reads the fight before it resolves. Less raw mana, more information, and spells that land on the future position.

payload.name: Timeweaver
payload.description: Chronomancer who braids short loops. Rewinds a mistake, or forces an enemy to repeat a bad beat.

payload.name: Paradox
payload.description: Chronomancer who breaks causality on purpose. Acts twice in a window where everyone else acts once.

payload.name: Crusader
payload.description: Templar on the offensive oath. Consecrated strikes that heal a sliver of the damage they deal.

payload.name: Oathkeeper
payload.description: Templar who holds the vow. Intercepts a blow meant for an ally and answers with a ward, not a chase.

payload.name: Judicator
payload.description: Arbiter who delivers sentence in an area. Guilt is a status, and the next spell spends it.

payload.name: Inquisitor
payload.description: Arbiter who questions with a blade. Mixes mana verdicts with melee so a silenced caster still dies.

payload.name: Abyss Herald
payload.description: Void Caller who keeps the rift open. Summons last longer and arrive already hostile to the marked target.

payload.name: Riftbinder
payload.description: Void Caller who anchors the tear to their own body. Fewer summons, harder to dispel, and a personal shield from the rift.

payload.name: Titanforger
payload.description: Golemancer of siege constructs. The golem is a second tank, and the caster hides in its shadow.

payload.name: Runesmith
payload.description: Golemancer who writes combat into the construct. Runes swap the golem between guard, slam, and pulse.

payload.name: Titan Pilot
payload.description: Mecha Pilot in a heavy frame. Slow to turn, brutal when the weapon system is online.

payload.name: Ace Frame
payload.description: Mecha Pilot in a light frame. Boosts, lock-on, and a cockpit that rewards the pilot who never stops moving.

payload.name: Gridmind
payload.description: Cyber-Architect who thinks in networks. Turrets, walls, and hacks share a single grid and buff each other.

payload.name: Nexus Engineer
payload.description: Cyber-Architect who builds a personal nexus. The node tanks, repairs devices, and punishes anyone who breaks a link.

payload.name: Bombardier
payload.description: Demolitionist of long arcs. Lobs shaped charges that detonate on a timer or on contact.

payload.name: Blastmaster
payload.description: Demolitionist who sculpts the blast. Smaller radius, higher pressure, and a knockback that opens the next charge.

payload.name: Ghost Protocol
payload.description: Netrunner who is never on the node they just touched. Hacks, relocates, and leaves a trace that lies.

payload.name: Daemon King
payload.description: Netrunner who installs a daemon and lets it work. Damage, silence, and stolen cooldowns tick without a second cast.

payload.name: Geneweaver
payload.description: Bio-Engineer who edits mid-fight. A splice can close a wound or force a mutation the target did not consent to.

payload.name: Vitaforge
payload.description: Bio-Engineer of living armor. Grows plates, shares regen, and turns the squad into a harder organism.

payload.name: Pestilence
payload.description: Plague Spreader whose strain jumps. One application becomes a cloud, then a second target, then the pack.

payload.name: Blightlord
payload.description: Plague Spreader who drinks their own work. Deals blight damage and converts a share of it into personal sustain.

payload.name: General Merchant
payload.title: Supplies Dealer
payload.description: A stout, weathered trader who has operated from the same stall in Nexus Core for over two decades. His worn ledger holds debts from half the district.
payload.greeting: Credits talk, everything else walks. What do you need?

payload.name: Master Blacksmith
payload.title: Forge Master
payload.description: A veteran smith who has equipped three generations of Concordium soldiers. His hands are more scar than skin.
payload.greeting: Steel doesn't care about feelings. Bring materials and coin, I'll do the rest.

payload.name: Innkeeper
payload.title: Rest & Recuperation
payload.description: A cheerful matron who runs the only reputable lodging in the district. She knows everyone's business and tells no one.
payload.greeting: Rest your feet, friend. Rooms are clean, food's hot, and I've heard it all — so save the excuses.

payload.name: Bounty & Quest Board
payload.title: Automated Terminal
payload.description: An automated posting terminal that aggregates Concordium-approved contracts and public bounties.
payload.greeting: [TERMINAL ACTIVE] Select contract category to proceed.

payload.name: Freelance Bounty Board
payload.title: Black Market Terminal
payload.description: A battered board covered in handwritten flyers, unofficial contracts, and the occasional wanted poster. No Concordium oversight here.
payload.greeting: [BOARD] Unstamped listings. No guarantees. Payment on delivery.

payload.name: Officer Valen
payload.title: Nexus Security
payload.description: An efficient Concordium field officer who processes security contracts and inter-faction liaison requests. His medals are real; his patience is not.
payload.greeting: Identification. Purpose. Proceed.

payload.name: Director Hale
payload.title: Concordium Administrator
payload.description: Director Hale oversees Concordium containment operations in the Inner Cradle. Cold and calculating, she treats casualties as acceptable variables.
payload.greeting: Every asset is expendable if the mission succeeds. I'll be direct with you.

payload.name: Overseer Vael
payload.title: Logistics Command
payload.description: A bureaucrat stationed at the outer boundary, cataloguing anomalous energy readings with obsessive precision.
payload.greeting: The readings are off again. Don't touch anything without filing a request.

payload.name: Scout Rian
payload.title: Recon Unit
payload.description: A young Concordium scout on rotation through the Gardens, cataloguing flora mutations and monster migration patterns.
payload.greeting: Eyes open out here — the mutations near the eastern cluster have been getting aggressive.

payload.name: Junk-Eye Joe
payload.title: Scavenger
payload.description: Junk-Eye Joe lost one eye to a collapsing ceiling in this very district. He replaced it with a salvaged scope lens and kept digging.
payload.greeting: Junk? Treasure? Same thing, different buyer. Let's talk.

payload.name: Guard Captain
payload.title: Outer Defense
payload.description: A seasoned guard captain who has held the eastern perimeter for eleven years. He's run out of things to be surprised by.
payload.greeting: Another contract? Fine. Just don't get killed where I can see it.

payload.name: Old Man Kael
payload.title: Veteran Explorer
payload.description: Old Man Kael claims to have explored every district before the Great Fracture. His stories contradict each other perfectly.
payload.greeting: Sit down. This'll take a minute. Or don't — your loss.

payload.name: Scholar Elara
payload.title: Aethel Researcher
payload.description: Scholar Elara specialises in Aethel resonance mapping. She has published seventeen papers. She mentions this within thirty seconds of meeting anyone.
payload.greeting: I'll spare you the background reading — just tell me what you know.

payload.name: Archivist Sylas
payload.title: Keeper of Records
payload.description: Archivist Sylas guards the Seekers' historical records with paranoid precision. He can recall exact shelf locations for 40,000 documents.
payload.greeting: Access is tiered. What clearance do you carry?

payload.name: Novice Finn
payload.title: Field Researcher
payload.description: Finn is enthusiastic to a fault and has already accidentally detonated two crystal clusters this season.
payload.greeting: Oh! You're here! I was just about to try something probably-safe!

payload.name: Mina
payload.title: Crystal Harvester
payload.description: Mina has spent years combing the Valley for pure Cradle Glass fragments. She sells the extras and keeps the finest for herself.
payload.greeting: I'll tell you right now — the good pieces aren't for sale. But I have plenty of the rest.

payload.name: Dax
payload.title: Deep Delver
payload.description: Dax descends into the Caverns daily and emerges with more data than anyone else alive. He's partially deaf from the resonance hum.
payload.greeting: What? Oh — yeah. Deep cave, lots of crystals, definitely haunted. Want specifics?

payload.name: Watcher Vane
payload.title: Observatory Guard
payload.description: Watcher Vane monitors Shard energy peaks from the highest post in the region. She hasn't slept a full night in two years.
payload.greeting: The readings spiked again. Something is building. I need a runner.

payload.name: Commander Drax
payload.title: Bastion Leader
payload.description: Commander Drax runs Bastion Core's offensive operations with zero tolerance for failure or excuses. His record is unbroken because he breaks people first.
payload.greeting: You want a job? Prove you're worth the oxygen first.

payload.name: Ironhand
payload.title: Elite Forgemaster
payload.description: Ironhand earned his name when his right arm was replaced with a hydraulic exo-limb after a forge accident. Best thing that ever happened to his craft.
payload.greeting: Hegemony steel or something you've dragged in from the wasteland. Either way, I can work with it.

payload.name: Rusty
payload.title: Scrap Dealer
payload.description: Rusty runs the most chaotic stall in the Scrap Field, selling things he definitely did not assemble himself and definitely works.
payload.greeting: Certified pre-owned! That's my official position and I'm sticking to it.

payload.name: Gorn
payload.title: Shift Foreman
payload.description: Gorn has mined the Ravine since before the Hegemony claimed it. He works for them now but misses the silence.
payload.greeting: Ores go down, iron comes up, credits change hands. That's all there is.

payload.name: Tink
payload.title: Salvage Expert
payload.description: Tink specialises in extracting usable components from decommissioned Hegemony war machines. Her shop smells of coolant and ambition.
payload.greeting: Every busted machine has one good thing left in it. I find it. You buy it. Works for everyone.

payload.name: Foreman Brigg
payload.title: Titan Assembly
payload.description: Foreman Brigg coordinates construction of Hegemony heavy units. He dispatches anyone who slows the line.
payload.greeting: Clock's running. Make it worth my time.

payload.name: Don Vercelli
payload.title: Cartel Underboss
payload.description: Don Vercelli controls the Port Meridian dockside trade with a smile that never quite reaches his eyes. Everyone owes him something.
payload.greeting: Welcome, welcome! Sit down. Have you eaten? Everyone eats at my table before we talk business.

payload.name: Old Salty
payload.title: Fisherman
payload.description: Old Salty has fished the Wetlands for fifty years and has opinions on everything. He shares them whether asked or not.
payload.greeting: Careful out past the orange markers — something big has been circling.

payload.name: Sly
payload.title: Smuggler
payload.description: Sly operates out of a camp so well hidden that even Cartel enforcers can't find it consistently. His prices reflect the inconvenience.
payload.greeting: You're either a customer or a problem. Which is it?

payload.name: Madam Z
payload.title: Contraband Dealer
payload.description: Madam Z runs the most sophisticated black-market operation in three sectors. Her network spans factions. Her records are encrypted to oblivion.
payload.greeting: Everything has a price. The question is what you're willing to offer.

payload.name: Kip
payload.title: Deep Diver
payload.description: Kip free-dives the submerged Aethel ruins for Cartel clients, recovering artifacts that pre-date the current age. She has drowned three times and keeps going.
payload.greeting: Got three contracts open and a window before the tide shifts. Short version: I need backup.

payload.name: Director Sterling
payload.title: OmniCorp Executive
payload.description: Director Sterling manages OmniCorp field operations with corporate detachment. He sees people as human capital.
payload.greeting: Your efficiency rating is under evaluation. Perform accordingly.

payload.name: Tech Officer 404
payload.title: Systems Analyst
payload.description: Tech Officer 404 handles everything from hardware diagnostics to covert extraction — and prefers not to explain why the two are related.
payload.greeting: Task assigned. Completion expected. Questions are inefficient.

payload.name: Surveyor Unit 7
payload.title: Automated Drone
payload.description: Surveyor Unit 7 is an autonomous OmniCorp drone with a remarkable personality subroutine that it has never been permitted to act on.
payload.greeting: Surveyor Unit 7 online. Please state your resource-extraction inquiry.

payload.name: Chief Barrett
payload.title: Extraction Operations
payload.description: Chief Barrett has run OmniCorp extraction sites for eighteen years. She is equal parts miner, geologist, and combat veteran.
payload.greeting: We're behind quota. If you're here to help, I'll be grateful. If not, get clear of the machinery.

payload.name: Warden AI
payload.title: Security Grid
payload.description: Warden AI manages access to OmniCorp's most sensitive mining operations. It has never once bent a rule.
payload.greeting: [WARDEN-7] Clearance verification required. Unauthorised access terminates this session.

payload.name: Engineer Cross
payload.title: Core Maintainer
payload.description: Engineer Cross keeps the Skybridge Reactor from melting down on a daily basis. He has not taken a day off in three years.
payload.greeting: I have exactly four minutes before the coolant flush. Talk fast.

payload.name: High Priestess Lyr
payload.title: Voice of the Shard
payload.description: High Priestess Lyr is the spiritual and operational leader of the Children of the Shard. She speaks in certainties because she has heard the Shard speak.
payload.greeting: The Shard has already seen this meeting. Come — what you seek to ask, it already knows.

payload.name: Acolyte Mera
payload.title: Forest Guide
payload.description: Acolyte Mera is the High Priestess' deputy and does most of the work that keeping a religious order running actually requires.
payload.greeting: Lyr handles the visions. I handle the schedules. What can I help you with?

payload.name: Brother Silas
payload.title: Acolyte
payload.description: Brother Silas tends the sacred Glowvine paths, pruning the luminescent vines and guiding pilgrims through the forest's more disorienting sections.
payload.greeting: Walk slowly here. The Glowvines respond to rushed energy.

payload.name: The Hermit
payload.title: Outcast
payload.description: The Hermit lives alone at the swamp's edge and claims the isolation is his by choice. His knowledge of Shard-touched flora is unmatched.
payload.greeting: The swamp provides. Coin helps too. What are you after?

payload.name: Keeper Norn
payload.title: Shrine Guardian
payload.description: Keeper Norn has maintained the Fragment Shrine for three generations of her family. The shrine remembers what history has tried to erase.
payload.greeting: Leave an offering, or don't — the Shard judges intent, not tribute.

payload.name: Guardian Rell
payload.title: Altar Defense
payload.description: Guardian Rell is the last of the Altar's sworn defenders. She speaks rarely and only when she has something worth saying.
payload.greeting: State your purpose at the Altar. Those who lie do not leave easily.

payload.name: General Kaelen
payload.title: Starforged Leader
payload.description: General Kaelen is the Starforged Legion's most decorated commander and the fortress' namesake ancestor's descendant. Every scar has a story.
payload.greeting: The Legion's wars are never truly over — they only pause. Come, there is work.

payload.name: Sergeant Korg
payload.title: Drill Master
payload.description: Sergeant Korg has broken and rebuilt more recruits than any drill sergeant in Legion history. He considers this a compliment.
payload.greeting: WHAT ARE YOU DOING STANDING THERE. Move, recruit!

payload.name: Scout Jace
payload.title: Forward Recon
payload.description: Scout Jace runs the farthest perimeter patrols alone and prefers it that way. She knows the dunes better than the sand knows itself.
payload.greeting: Sandstorm coming from the west in three hours. You'll want to be clear of the flats.

payload.name: Rex
payload.title: Wasteland Survivor
payload.description: Rex survived a collapse in the Mesa Warpath and set up the only trading post between the Badlands and the Fortress. He charges accordingly.
payload.greeting: Prices are high because everything out here costs blood to move. Pay or move on.

payload.name: Veteran Gorok
payload.title: Warpath Defender
payload.description: Veteran Gorok fought in the Mesa Warpath campaigns and returned to guard the memorial. He gives contracts to those who understand what they're walking into.
payload.greeting: Read the names on the wall before you take any contract from me. All of them.

payload.name: Smithy Dan
payload.title: Lost Blacksmith
payload.description: Smithy Dan set up a forge in the middle of nowhere after being blacklisted by every guild. His work is better than his manners.
payload.greeting: Took the long route to find me. Good — means you actually need something forged right.

payload.name: Medic Vance
payload.title: Combat Medic
payload.description: Medic Vance works the neutral zone, patching up anyone from any faction. He says he has no politics. Everyone believes him.
payload.greeting: Wound first, introductions second. Sit down.

payload.name: Traveling Merchant
payload.title: Rare Goods
payload.description: The Traveling Merchant has no fixed location and appears at crossroads when least expected. Some say they're the same person across decades; others say they're a fleet.
payload.greeting: The rare finds the rare. You've found me — so you must be looking for something unusual.

payload.name: Scout Jax
payload.title: Storm Chaser
payload.description: Scout Jax goes where no briefing covers and comes back with information no intel team was willing to get.
payload.greeting: I've been to the dead zones. Twice. Still alive, so clearly I'm doing something right.

payload.name: Commander Tark
payload.title: Frontline Ops
payload.description: Commander Tark leads a multi-faction peacekeeping force that nobody actually obeys. He keeps trying anyway.
payload.greeting: Nobody is cooperating. Again. Are you here to help or to make things worse?

payload.name: Nameless Walker
payload.title: Void Touched
payload.description: The Nameless Walker exists between states — half in this world, half in the Void. They offer guidance but no comfort.
payload.greeting: You see me. Most do not. That means the Void has noticed you already.

payload.name: The Prophet
payload.title: Doomsayer
payload.description: The Prophet claims to have seen how every faction ends. His predictions are specific, detailed, and have a troubling accuracy rate.
payload.greeting: I see you've come to hear something terrible. I'll oblige.

payload.name: Tech Lead Aris
payload.title: Siphon Control
payload.description: Tech Lead Aris maintains the most dangerous energy extraction operation in the Concordium — a job that has taken three predecessors.
payload.greeting: The Core is stable. For now. I need someone who can run interference on the eastern conduit.

payload.name: Master Kael
payload.title: Legendary Forgesmith
payload.description: Master Kael is the only living crafter authorised to work with Prima Materia. He accepts commissions once per season, if he finds the requester worthy.
payload.greeting: Most people who come here aren't ready. Convince me you're different.

payload.name: Xylar the Abyssal
payload.title: Void Crafter
payload.description: Xylar the Abyssal forges weapons using Void-touched metal that no standard smith will touch. The products are extraordinary. So is the risk.
payload.greeting: Void-forged items remember their makers. I only work for those who will be remembered in turn.

payload.name: Echo of Aethelgard
payload.title: Lost Spirit
payload.description: The Echo of Aethelgard is a residual consciousness from before the Fracture, preserved in a crystalline matrix. Its memories are the only record of the old world.
payload.greeting: You stand in what was once a great city. I am what remembers it.

payload.name: The Resonance
payload.title: Sentient Energy
payload.description: The Resonance is an entity formed from accumulated Aethel energy, neither fully conscious nor fully absent. It responds to genuine questions.
payload.greeting: ... (the air crackles with recognition)

payload.name: Orbital Custodian Prime
payload.title: Sentinel AI
payload.description: Orbital Custodian Prime is the administrative intelligence of the Custodian orbital station. Neutral in all factional conflicts; ruthless in operational efficiency.
payload.greeting: [CUSTODIAN PRIME] Authenticated connection established. What resource allocation do you require?

payload.name: Aurelia Voss
payload.title: Concordium Treasury Officer
payload.description: Aurelia Voss manages the Concordium's official currency exchange desk with meticulous records and an unbreakable smile.
payload.greeting: Standard rates apply. Concordium Credit at today's official rate — no black market here.

payload.name: Magister Kael
payload.title: Arcanum Financial Archivist
payload.description: Magister Kael handles Quanta exchange for the Seekers and treats every transaction as a mathematical puzzle.
payload.greeting: The exchange rate is derived from 14 variables. I'll spare you the formula.

payload.name: Commander Rhyx
payload.title: Hegemony Quartermaster
payload.description: Commander Rhyx runs the Hegemony treasury with the same no-nonsense approach he applies to everything. Rates are fair, service is fast.
payload.greeting: Ingots in, credits out. Or the reverse. State your requirement.

payload.name: Silas Vey
payload.title: Meridian Trade Broker
payload.description: Silas Vey runs the Cartel's exchange floor and makes more from the spread than the official rate would suggest.
payload.greeting: The best rates in three sectors — according to me, which is who matters here.

payload.name: Director Harlan
payload.title: OmniCorp Asset Manager
payload.description: Director Harlan oversees OmniCorp's currency operations. He does not smile during exchange; smiling reduces throughput by 0.4%.
payload.greeting: OmniCred exchange window is open. Minimum transaction: 50 units.

payload.name: Elder Myr
payload.title: Shard Treasury Keeper
payload.description: Elder Myr manages the Aethel-Tithe exchange with a spiritual narrative attached to each transaction.
payload.greeting: The Shard's currency is faith. Aethel-Tithes are its earthly form. Let us exchange with gratitude.

payload.name: Varkon Thal
payload.title: Legion Paymaster
payload.description: Varkon Thal manages Legion Scrip disbursement and exchange with the same brutal efficiency as a weapons inspection.
payload.greeting: Rate's posted on the board. No negotiation. Scrip in, credits out — move along.

payload.name: Custodian IX
payload.title: Galactic Treasury Delegate
payload.description: Custodian IX handles Custodian cross-currency exchange. Its rate algorithm is updated every 60 seconds based on galactic market feeds.
payload.greeting: [CUSTODIAN-IX] Exchange protocol active. Rate refreshed 12 seconds ago.

payload.name: Commander Ross
payload.title: Civil Defense Commander
payload.description: Commander Ross leads the Concordium's high-risk operations in the fractured core regions. She gives orders calmly and expects them followed precisely.
payload.greeting: I have three missions that need immediate assignment. Priorities, in order.

payload.name: Strategist Elara
payload.title: Cradle Tactical Command
payload.description: Strategist Elara analyses the Storm Belt anomalies and translates raw data into actionable field assignments.
payload.greeting: The Storm Belt follows patterns. I know them. I'll tell you where to be.

payload.name: Researcher Vin
payload.title: Arcanum Field Researcher
payload.description: Researcher Vin is deep in a classified study of the Cavern's resonance peaks and needs reliable field agents who ask fewer questions.
payload.greeting: Yes, yes — come in. Just don't touch the crystal array. Or that. Or — actually, touch nothing.

payload.name: Admiral Soren
payload.title: Fleet Command
payload.description: Admiral Soren commands the Custodian orbital fleet and coordinates missions that require both orbital and ground assets.
payload.greeting: From orbit, everything looks small. From the ground, nothing feels small. I need agents who understand both.

payload.name: Instructor Kael
payload.title: Concordium Combat Trainer
payload.description: Instructor Kael teaches Concordium combat doctrines and class advancement to qualified recruits.
payload.greeting: Advancement requires preparation. Let's assess where you stand.

payload.name: Archsage Myr
payload.title: Arcanum Discipline Mentor
payload.description: Archsage Myr guides Arcanum class advancement with esoteric methods that produce undeniable results.
payload.greeting: Your path is written in resonance. I help you read it.

payload.name: War Marshal Drax
payload.title: Iron Hegemony War Instructor
payload.description: War Marshal Drax has produced more elite soldiers than any trainer in Hegemony history. He is not gentle about it.
payload.greeting: You want advancement? Show me you've earned the right to ask for it.

payload.name: Commander Lyra
payload.title: Galactic Custodian Tactical Mentor
payload.description: Commander Lyra trains operatives in Custodian tactical frameworks — precise, modular, and faction-agnostic.
payload.greeting: Class advancement follows protocol. Protocol follows evidence. Present your record.

payload.name: Old Veteran Korr
payload.title: Freelancer Combat Instructor
payload.description: Old Veteran Korr has fought for everyone and against everyone. He trains for effectiveness, not allegiance.
payload.greeting: I don't care who you fight for. I care how well you fight. Big difference.

payload.name: Architect Ardyn
payload.title: Class Ascension Mentor
payload.description: Architect Ardyn designs custom advancement paths for unconventional builds. Her methods are considered borderline heretical by most class guilds.
payload.greeting: The standard paths are fine for standard people. Shall we explore what else is possible?

payload.name: Captain Vex
payload.title: Cartel Combat Broker
payload.description: Captain Vex trains Cartel operatives in infiltration and combat. The facility doesn't officially exist.
payload.greeting: You found this place. That's already the first test. You passed.

payload.name: Director Astra Vey
payload.title: OmniCorp Combat Systems Instructor
payload.description: Director Astra Vey manages OmniCorp's elite class programme with corporate KPIs and genuine tactical brilliance.
payload.greeting: OmniCorp class advancement is metric-based. Your last performance determined your eligibility.

payload.name: Oracle Seraphel
payload.title: Shard Ascension Guide
payload.description: Oracle Seraphel channels Shard energy to unlock class potential. Sessions are intense and leave participants changed.
payload.greeting: The Shard does not grant power cheaply. Are you prepared to pay its price?

payload.name: Centurion Valka
payload.title: Legion Combat Drillmaster
payload.description: Centurion Valka trains Legion fighters in the ancient combat traditions. Advancement means surviving her drills.
payload.greeting: Legion advancement is earned in combat. Step onto the sand.

payload.name: Guide Axiom
payload.title: Combat Orientation AI
payload.description: Guide Axiom is an info-broker who knows the class system inside out and helps wanderers find their correct advancement path.
payload.greeting: You look lost, which is normal. The class system is complex. Let me map it for you.

payload.name: Arwick Voss
payload.title: Crossroad Merchant
payload.description: A wandering trader from the Bastion who settled at the Crossroads. Sells basic supplies.
payload.greeting: Welcome to the Crossroads, traveler! Need supplies for the road ahead?

payload.name: Mira Solace
payload.title: Crossroad Innkeeper
payload.description: A former Concordium medic who opened an inn at the Crossroads.
payload.greeting: Rough journey? Rest here. All factions welcome under this roof.

payload.name: Dhurn Ironhand
payload.title: Crossroad Blacksmith
payload.description: An Iron Hegemony-trained smith who left the Bastion for neutral ground.
payload.greeting: Need something forged? My hammer cares not for faction allegiance — only quality.

payload.name: Crossroad Bounty Board
payload.title: Neutral Quest Terminal
payload.description: A holographic terminal displaying bounties and contracts from all factions.
payload.greeting: BOUNTY TERMINAL v3.2 — Select contract...

payload.name: Magister Venn
payload.title: AMA Exchange Officer
payload.description: An Aegis Monetary Authority representative facilitating faction currency exchange to CRD.
payload.greeting: The Credent is universal. Exchange your faction currency here — equal rates for all.

payload.name: Envoy Kalen
payload.title: Custodian Envoy
payload.description: A Galactic Custodian envoy station. Provides lore, news, and direction to travelers.
payload.greeting: Greetings, wanderer. I am Envoy Kalen, servant of the Custodians. How may the galaxy assist you today?

payload.name: Director Hallen
payload.title: Bazaar Merchant Lord
payload.description: A former OmniCorp executive running the Central Spire's premier trading post.
payload.greeting: Welcome to the Central Spire Bazaar! The finest goods from every corner of Xylos.

payload.name: Keeper Sora
payload.title: Spire Innkeeper
payload.description: A Children of the Shard acolyte who runs a sanctuary for weary travelers.
payload.greeting: The Spire welcomes all. Rest, heal, and continue your journey with renewed spirit.

payload.name: Forge-Master Tarn
payload.title: Spire Blacksmith
payload.description: A master smith who studied under every faction's forging traditions.
payload.greeting: Every faction's forging secrets, combined in one forge. What shall we create?

payload.name: Auditor Corvan
payload.title: AMA Senior Auditor
payload.description: A senior AMA auditor overseeing large-volume currency exchange operations.
payload.greeting: Large volume exchange? I handle the accounts that shape planetary economies.

payload.name: Envoy Seris
payload.title: Custodian Envoy
payload.description: A Custodian envoy monitoring faction dynamics from the Spire.
payload.greeting: The Custodians watch over Xylos. I am here to guide, inform, and — when necessary — protect.

payload.name: Grand Merchant Aria
payload.title: Orbital Trade Director
payload.description: The director of the Orbital Hub's trade network. Deals in legendary-grade equipment.
payload.greeting: Welcome to Xylos orbit. Here, the rarest treasures change hands. What do you seek?

payload.name: Sanctuary AI 'Lyra7'
payload.title: Orbital Sanctuary
payload.description: An AI-operated sanctuary pod providing full restoration services.
payload.greeting: Sanctuary Protocol Active. Please enter pod for full bio-restoration. Estimated time: 0.5 cycles.

payload.name: Master Smith Orion
payload.title: Orbital Forge Master
payload.description: The legendary forge master who crafts weapons for faction leaders.
payload.greeting: I've forged for generals and legends. Let's see if you're worthy of my best work.

payload.name: Chancellor Arden Vey
payload.title: AMA Chancellor
payload.description: The AMA Chancellor overseeing all Xylos currency operations from orbit.
payload.greeting: The Credent is the pulse of galactic economy. Exchange wisely — fortunes rise and fall in moments.

payload.name: Lord Envoy Thalos
payload.title: Senior Custodian Envoy
payload.description: A senior Custodian envoy with authority to negotiate on behalf of the Conclave.
payload.greeting: I speak for the Conclave of Voices. The Custodians have watched Xylos for millennia. What would you know?

payload.name: Magister Corrin
payload.title: AMA Concordium Branch
payload.description: AMA branch officer for Concordium territory.
payload.greeting: AMA Concordium Branch. Exchange your AMC for Credent at the current rate.

payload.name: Scholar Tel
payload.title: AMA Arcanum Branch
payload.description: AMA branch officer for Arcanum territory.
payload.greeting: AMA Arcanum Branch. Exchange your Quanta for Credent at the current rate.

payload.name: Quartermaster Tor
payload.title: AMA Hegemony Branch
payload.description: AMA branch officer for Iron Hegemony territory.
payload.greeting: AMA Hegemony Branch. Exchange your Ingots for Credent at the current rate.

payload.name: Broker Quinn
payload.title: AMA Meridian Branch
payload.description: AMA branch officer for Meridian Cartel territory.
payload.greeting: AMA Meridian Branch. Exchange your Aurum Cipher for Credent at the current rate.

payload.name: Director Haas
payload.title: AMA OmniCorp Branch
payload.description: AMA branch officer for OmniCorp territory.
payload.greeting: AMA OmniCorp Branch. Exchange your OmniCred for Credent at the current rate.

payload.name: Elder Nym
payload.title: AMA Shard Branch
payload.description: AMA branch officer for Children of the Shard territory.
payload.greeting: AMA Shard Branch. Exchange your Aethel-Tithes for Credent at the current rate.

payload.name: Paymaster Zara
payload.title: AMA Legion Branch
payload.description: AMA branch officer for Starforged Legion territory.
payload.greeting: AMA Legion Branch. Exchange your Legion Scrip for Credent at the current rate.

payload.name: Quartermaster Voss
payload.title: Concordium Quartermaster
payload.description: Official merchant of Concordium. Sells faction-approved equipment and supplies.
payload.greeting: Welcome to the Concordium supply depot. What do you need, operative?

payload.name: Archivist Thel
payload.title: Arcanum Archivist Merchant
payload.description: Official merchant of The Arcanum Seekers. Sells faction-approved equipment and supplies.
payload.greeting: Welcome to the The Arcanum Seekers supply depot. What do you need, operative?

payload.name: Armorer Drax
payload.title: Hegemony Armorer
payload.description: Official merchant of Iron Hegemony. Sells faction-approved equipment and supplies.
payload.greeting: Welcome to the Iron Hegemony supply depot. What do you need, operative?

payload.name: Broker Quinn
payload.title: Cartel Broker
payload.description: Official merchant of Meridian Cartel. Sells faction-approved equipment and supplies.
payload.greeting: Welcome to the Meridian Cartel supply depot. What do you need, operative?

payload.name: Supply Director Haas
payload.title: OmniCorp Supply Director
payload.description: Official merchant of Omnicorp. Sells faction-approved equipment and supplies.
payload.greeting: Welcome to the Omnicorp supply depot. What do you need, operative?

payload.name: Keeper Nym
payload.title: Shard Keeper Merchant
payload.description: Official merchant of Children Of The Shard. Sells faction-approved equipment and supplies.
payload.greeting: Welcome to the Children Of The Shard supply depot. What do you need, operative?

payload.name: Quartermaster Zara
payload.title: Legion Quartermaster
payload.description: Official merchant of Starforged Legion. Sells faction-approved equipment and supplies.
payload.greeting: Welcome to the Starforged Legion supply depot. What do you need, operative?

payload.name: AMA Officer Petra Calloway
payload.title: Aegis Monetary Authority — Concordium Branch
payload.description: Petra is a sharp-eyed AMA officer stationed at the Concordium capital. She maintains strict neutrality despite being surrounded by military culture. Known for her no-nonsense approach to exchange transactions and her habit of auditing the local treasury records 'just to keep everyone honest.'
payload.greeting: AMA Branch Office — Concordium. Present your credentials and state the volume of your exchange. I process transactions, not small talk.

payload.name: AMA Scholar Drex Nul
payload.title: Aegis Monetary Authority — Arcanum Branch
payload.description: Drex is a former Arcanum Seekers student who became more interested in economic theory than arcane knowledge. He writes papers on 'The Thermodynamics of Galactic Currency Flows' in his spare time.
payload.greeting: Ah, a transaction seeker! The economic relationship between Arcane currency and the Credent is fascinating — particularly when you examine the volatility coefficients. But yes, I can exchange your currency. Let me pull up the current rates.

payload.name: AMA Terminal IH-3
payload.title: Aegis Monetary Authority — Iron Hegemony Automated Terminal
payload.description: The Iron Hegemony preferred efficiency over personality, so they lobbied for an automated AMA terminal. IH-3 processes transactions with industrial efficiency and has no patience for errors.
payload.greeting: TERMINAL IH-3 ACTIVE. INSERT CURRENCY VOLUME. EXCHANGE RATE DISPLAYED. CONFIRM OR ABORT. PROCESSING FEE APPLIES.

payload.name: AMA Broker Sable Thorn
payload.title: Aegis Monetary Authority — Meridian Branch
payload.description: Sable Thorn navigated from Cartel trader to AMA broker with calculated grace. The Meridian branch is the busiest in Xylos by transaction volume. She occasionally tips clients about exchange rate trends.
payload.greeting: Welcome, welcome! You've come to the right desk — the Meridian AMA branch handles more volume than all other branches combined. What are we converting today?

payload.name: AMA Node OM-7
